residentialNameRules.pattern: ^the cut list: \d+ pieces, \d+ board feet, 2x6 studs ordered as 8' stock$
residentialNameRules.name: the cut list: {pieces} pieces, {boardFeet} board feet, 2x6 studs ordered as 8' stock
residentialNameRules.reason: Framing quantities differ with accepted wall assemblies; retain the assertion and original measured label, not a fixed measurement target.

residentialNameRules.name: web-ifc (oracle): {members} members in four assemblies
residentialNameRules.reason: Read-back count is checked against actual members, whose count/order varies with retained wall/framing behavior.

opsTimingRule.pattern: ^(heat loss per room between 0 and 200 W\/m² of floor \([\d, ]+ W\/m²\)); \d+ ms in all$
opsTimingRule.reason: Elapsed milliseconds are telemetry, not the heat-loss predicate. Retain original measuredCases and compare all physical measurements unchanged.
